data.title: Witness summons (Zeugenladung) – Amtsgericht Musterquedlin
data.summary: The Amtsgericht Musterquedlin summons the recipient as a witness in the civil case Beispielharz Dachbau GmbH against Marion Kessler concerning payment for work (Werklohn), for a hearing on 13 January 2027 at 09:00 in Saal 104.
data.explanation: This is a court summons asking you to appear as a witness, not as a party to the lawsuit. Bring this letter and an official ID to the hearing. If you fail to attend without a sufficient excuse, the court can charge you for the costs this causes and impose a fine (Ordnungsgeld) under §380 ZPO. Travel costs and lost earnings may be reimbursed under the JVEG. If you have a valid reason you cannot attend, contact the court's office beforehand to ask to be excused; otherwise simply attend at the stated date and time.
